title: Gnome World: Which Parts Are Hazel

builds.hazel: the rules compiled in the page by hazel-jit, from build.hazel.org/hazeljs (hazelgrove/hazel#2857, branch hazeljs)
builds.run: the laptop, the Claude desktop app's browser pane (Chromium), Gnome world with ?test=1, 2026-11-24 08:0x MST, one run

measures.callMs: milliseconds a call, each Hazel function called in the page (World.step 2,000 times, World.plan 5, World.roots 20, the others 2,000 or 500) and averaged, once
measures.stepMs: a step of the world without drawing, and its water step, from timing added during 0.0.102's development
measures.sizes: characters of code: each Hazel top-level definition with its comments taken out; JavaScript's top-level functions grouped by name
